title: 第17章 精灵与魅魔第18章 贵族青年
slug: 兼职管理女子监狱的异端审判官
content_zh:
天色微亮的鸢尾花监狱
“哈啊～”
沙发上的狄曼列被魔导手环的震动强行唤醒过来，迷迷糊糊的睁开了眼睛
些许光线进入他的视线，随之而来的便是白发美少女的容颜
感受了一下精灵的柔软大腿，狄曼列感觉自己都有点想哭了：“做梦一样的穿越生活啊”
但下一刻，两滴泪水就真的从他眼角流了下来：“要是这世界没那么狗屎就好了........”
“这句话我好像平均一年就会听你说一次”
尽管狄曼列想再享受一会儿精灵美少女膝枕的这份美好，但终究还是要面对现实，他也缓缓坐了起来
“那么，一步步慢慢来吧，目前也没有影响到水晶城，从小角色开始解决”
狄曼列拿过手杖，来到了办公室的窗前，他能感觉到鸢尾花监狱门口多了几个身影，显然卡里伯爵还没有蠢到直接逃跑，但他似乎也不甘心就这么被送去见死神
狄曼列眯了眯眼，略微活动了一下手指：“这么多年了，还是受不了一些家伙的愚蠢程度”
“那个卡里伯爵天刚亮就在监狱门口了”
露诺表情变的有些嫌弃：“就是他制作那种灵魂**吧，你准备怎么办？”
“审判异端”
仅仅四个字，狄曼列像是换了个人一般，声音毫无感情和起伏
狄曼列迈开步伐办公室外走去：“他只是个小角色，我已经通知过帝国行政部和司法部了，新的水晶城管理者应该已经在路上了”
“这么效率”，露诺跟上了狄曼列：“那成瘾的灵魂药物........”
“生产工厂和成品全毁掉了”，狄曼列的手杖随着步伐点在地面：
“这东西还没散播出去，没造成影响，他们的老巢肯定在水晶城外，不然水晶城里任何的异常都会被我发现”
“你是说这件事的幕后黑手吗？他们是什么人？”

“经典的异端”
“什么底细？”
“和神有关”
听见狄曼列的话，露诺忍不住停下了脚步，看向身旁的狄曼列，眼中泛起担忧：“非要你去解决吗？这太危险了”
“这是我的工作，别担心，只是和神有关”
“怎么可能不担心？！！！”
随着露诺突然的怒喝，狄曼列也被吓了一跳，看向了露诺被不忿布满的精致脸庞
眼看这位精灵少女生气，狄曼列也是赶忙握住了她的手：“别生气别生气，真不危险的啦”
“我听你在这胡说！”，露诺甩开了狄曼列的手：“平时也就算了，为什么这种事非要你一个受伤了的人去解决？异端审判局是没人了吗？！”
“不是的啦”，狄曼列无奈的陪笑了一下：“而且真没什么太危险的.......”
“那是神明！！！”
露诺猛的抓住了狄曼列胸口的衣服：“你忘了自己怎么受伤的了？！你差点死掉，现在你还要牵扯进去！”
听着露诺的声音，狄曼列也只能安慰顺便搪塞着，有些事他不太方便对露诺说，露诺大概率也理解不了，甚至会引发一些影响
最终，露诺也是冷静了下来，冷哼一声后转身朝狄曼列的办公室走去：“随你去吧，典狱长大人”
看着准备去继续处理监狱事务的露诺，狄曼列也是只能无奈的笑了笑，然后继续朝鸢尾花监狱的门口走去
手杖轻点在地面，狄曼列也来到了鸢尾花女子监狱的广场
这个时候正有一部分犯人在放风时间，些许阳光也洒落在她们的身上
至于阳光哪来的，某位正在干活的龙娘应该最清楚了
狄曼列看了一眼穿着囚服正在水泥和泥沙间穿梭的元素精灵龙少女，抬手招呼了一名狱警
约莫二十几岁的女狱警赶忙快步跑向狄曼列，恭敬的立定：“典狱长”

狄曼列示意了一下卖力干活的龙娘：“维罗娜这个犯人怎么样”
content_en:
The Iris Prison in the light of day
"Haa~"
Diamanlie on the sofa was forcibly awakened by the vibration of the magic bracelet, and he opened his eyes in a daze.
A little light entered his sight, and what followed was the face of a beautiful white-haired girl.
After feeling the elf's soft thighs, Diamanlie felt like he wanted to cry: "It's like traveling through life in a dream."
But the next moment, two tears really flowed from the corners of his eyes: "It would be great if the world wasn't so shit..."
"I seem to hear you say this once a year on average."
Although Diamanlie wanted to enjoy the beauty of the beautiful elf girl's lap pillow for a while longer, he still had to face reality after all, and he slowly sat up.
"Then, let's take it step by step slowly. It hasn't affected Crystal City yet. Let's start with small roles."
Diamanlie took the cane and came to the window of the office. He could feel a few more figures at the door of Iris Prison. It was obvious that Count Cary was not stupid enough to escape directly, but he seemed unwilling to be sent to meet the God of Death.
Diamanlie narrowed his eyes and moved his fingers slightly: "After all these years, I still can't stand how stupid some guys are."
"That Earl of Cary was at the prison gate at dawn."
Lunuo's expression turned disgusting: "He is the one who makes that kind of soul bomb, what are you going to do?"
"Judgement of Heretics"
With just four words, Diamanlie seemed to be a different person, his voice was emotionless and undulating.
Dimanlie walked out of the office: "He is just a small role. I have already informed the Imperial Administration Department and the Ministry of Justice. The new Crystal City manager should be on the way."
"So efficient", Lunuo followed Dimanlie: "That addictive soul drug..."
"The production factory and finished products were all destroyed." Diamanlie's cane clicked on the ground as he walked:
"This thing has not spread yet and has no impact. Their home base must be outside Crystal City, otherwise I will discover any abnormalities in Crystal City."
"Are you talking about the people behind this? Who are they?"
"Classic Heresy"
"What details?"
“Related to God”
Hearing Diamanlie's words, Lunuo couldn't help but stop and looked at Diamanlie beside her, with worry in her eyes: "Do you have to solve it? This is too dangerous."
"This is my job, don't worry, it's just about God."
"How could you not be worried?!!!"
Following Lunuo's sudden roar, Diamanlie was also startled and looked at Lunuo's delicate face filled with anger.
Seeing that the elf girl was angry, Dimanlie quickly held her hand: "Don't be angry, don't be angry, it's really not dangerous."
"I hear you talking nonsense here!" Lunuo shook off Diamanlie's hand: "It's okay in normal times, why do you have to solve this kind of thing as an injured person? Is there no one in the Heretic Tribunal?!"
"No," Di Manlie smiled helplessly: "And it's really nothing too dangerous..."
"That's a god!!!"
Lunuo grabbed the clothes on Diamanlie's chest fiercely: "Have you forgotten how you were injured?! You almost died, and now you are still involved!"
Listening to Lunuo's voice, Diamanlie could only comfort and prevaricate. There were some things that were not convenient for him to tell Lunuo. Lunuo would most likely not be able to understand them, and it might even cause some repercussions.
In the end, Lunuo also calmed down, snorted coldly, turned around and walked towards Dimanlie's office: "As you go, Mr. Warden"
Seeing Lunuo who was about to continue handling prison affairs, Dimanlie could only smile helplessly, and then continued to walk towards the entrance of Iris Prison.
With his cane tapping the ground, Demanlie also arrived at the square of the Iris Women's Prison.
At this time, some prisoners were taking a break, and some sunlight was shining on them.on their bodies
As for where the sunshine comes from, a certain dragon lady who is working should know best.
Dimanlie glanced at the elemental elf dragon girl who was wearing prison uniform and shuttled between cement and sand, and raised her hand to greet a prison guard.
A female prison guard in her twenties hurriedly ran towards Dimanlie and said respectfully: "Warden"
Diamanlie gestured to the dragon lady who was working hard: "How about the prisoner Verona?"
